$description: Homeport design tokens. Generated from tokens.json - do not edit.

bg.$description: Page and app background (MudBlazor Background). Light: harbor fog. Dark: night water.

surface.$description: Cards, tables, drawer, landing sections (MudBlazor Surface, DrawerBackground).

surface-sunken.$description: Wells: code blocks, table header rows, input fills, skeleton base.

surface-raised.$description: Menus, dialogs, popovers. In dark, height is shown by a lighter surface, not by shadow alone.

surface-inverse.$description: Tooltips and chart tooltips. Text on it: ink-inverse.

appbar.$description: Portal app bar and landing top bar. Text: appbar-ink. Focus here: focus-on-inverse.

appbar-ink.$description: Text and icons on appbar (15.6:1 light, 15.4:1 dark).

line.$description: Hairline dividers and table lines. Decorative only, never the only boundary of a control.

line-strong.$description: Input and control borders, chart quota line. 3.6:1 on surface (light), 3.8:1 (dark).

ink.$description: Primary text on bg, surface, surface-sunken, surface-raised (>=13:1 both themes).

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, labels, axis labels, metadata on every surface (>=6.2:1 light, >=7.2:1 dark).

ink-disabled.$description: Disabled text and icons only (WCAG exempts disabled controls). Never for readable content.

harbor-navy.$description: The brand ink. App-icon tile, logo on light grounds. Same in both themes.

primary.$description: Portal primary actions, links, selected nav, active tab. As text on every surface (>=6.2:1 light, >=7:1 dark).

on-primary.$description: Text and icons on a primary fill (7.2:1 light, 8.5:1 dark).

primary-soft.$description: Selected row, active nav item background. Text on it: primary or ink.

accent.$description: Harbor light. Landing CTA fill, logo container, highlights. Never a status, never text on light grounds.

on-accent.$description: Text on an accent fill (9:1 light, 11:1 dark).

accent-edge.$description: 1px border on accent fills so the button edge reads on white (4.2:1).

accent-ink.$description: Accent as text: eyebrows, small highlights (6.2:1 on surface light, 10.3:1 dark).

focus.$description: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on bg, surface, sunken and raised (>=6.2:1 light, >=7:1 dark). Same as MudBlazor Primary, so portal and site match.

focus-on-inverse.$description: Focus ring on appbar and surface-inverse (10:1).

navlight-port.$description: Decorative red port light. Landing dividers and hero only. Never near status UI.

navlight-starboard.$description: Decorative green starboard light. Pairs with navlight-port. Never near status UI.

illus-line.$description: Illustration strokes. Same in both themes (4.6:1 on white, 3.8:1 on dark surface).

illus-water.$description: Illustration water lines and secondary strokes.

illus-light.$description: Illustration highlight: harbor lights, the docked container, dawn sun.

success.$description: Success / healthy. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

success-soft.$description: Background for success badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: success (>=5.1:1).

warning.$description: Warning / degraded. An orange, kept apart from the gold accent by lightness (light) and hue (dark). As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

warning-soft.$description: Background for warning badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: warning (>=5.1:1).

error.$description: Error / unreachable. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

error-soft.$description: Background for error badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: error (>=5.1:1).

info.$description: Info notices. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

info-soft.$description: Background for info badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: info (>=5.1:1).

neutral.$description: Neutral state / draining. Planned, not a problem. As text or icon on every surface (>=5:1). Always with icon + label.

neutral-soft.$description: Background for neutral badges, alerts and banners. Text on it: neutral (>=5.1:1).

state-healthy.$description: Module state healthy. Always with icon circle-check and the word 'healthy'.

state-degraded.$description: Module state degraded. Always with icon triangle-alert and the word 'degraded'.

state-unreachable.$description: Module state unreachable. Always with icon circle-x and the word 'unreachable'.

state-draining.$description: Module state draining. Always with icon arrow-down-to-line and the word 'draining'.

viz-1.$description: Categorical slot 1 (blue). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

viz-2.$description: Categorical slot 2 (orange). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

viz-3.$description: Categorical slot 3 (aqua). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light: needs direct labels or table.

viz-4.$description: Categorical slot 4 (yellow). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light: needs direct labels or table.

viz-5.$description: Categorical slot 5 (magenta). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank. Below 3:1 on light: needs direct labels or table.

viz-6.$description: Categorical slot 6 (green). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

viz-7.$description: Categorical slot 7 (violet). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

viz-8.$description: Categorical slot 8 (red). Assign in fixed order, by entity, never by rank.

seq-100.$description: Sequential usage intensity (heatmaps). 100 = near zero, 700 = peak. Dark theme reverses so low values recede into the night.

radius-xs.$description: Chart bar ends, focus-ring corners on tight items.

focus-offset.$description: Gap between element and focus ring.

duration-slow.$description: Dialogs, landing reveal of the docking container.

ease-standard.$description: Most transitions: settle into place, like a ship easing into a berth.

bp-md.$description: Site: desktop nav; portal: drawer docks (MudBlazor Md).

bp-xl.$description: Portal: max content width cap (MudBlazor Xl).

display.$description: Landing hero claim only. 36px/40px below 600px width.

h2.$description: Landing sub-sections; portal page title on wide screens.

h3.$description: Portal page title (MudBlazor H4/H5 map here).

h5.$description: Panel titles, pillar titles on mobile.

body-sm.$description: Portal default text, tables, forms (MudBlazor Body2).

label.$description: Buttons, tabs, nav items. Sentence case, no uppercase.

small.$description: Helper text, chart legends, badge text.

overline.$description: Landing eyebrows in accent-ink; uppercase via CSS only.

code-sm.$description: Inline code, IDs, API keys, client IDs.

num.$description: Numbers in tables and chart tooltips. Right-aligned. Mono is tabular by design.

stat.$description: Stat tile value. Sans with tabular-nums.
